# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy and student  <sub>[v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a chubby, handsome boy with little, bare, brown heels. He has short hair and a lively, restless demeanor.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, highly inquisitive, and mischievous boy who struggles to sit still. He frequently gets into trouble through impulsive actions, such as climbing where he shouldn't, pulling feathers from roosters, or playing pranks on his sister. Despite his naughty streak, he is deeply affectionate, honest about his misdeeds, and quick to show warmth through enthusiastic bear hugs. He idolizes Anne, listening eagerly to her guidance and striving to become better.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c17 P27](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0027), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c19 P45](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0045), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)_

- Mischievous and playful  <sub>[v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>
- Inquisitive  <sub>[v2 c22 P8](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0008)</sub>
- Affectionate  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)</sub>
- Restless and energetic  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c22 P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Winding and untying string or netting balls  <sub>[v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a good boy and protect his sister Dora  <sub>[v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- To get feathers for an Indian headdress  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>
- To grow up to become a storekeeper like Mr. Blair

## History

Following the death of his mother in East Grafton, Davy and his twin sister Dora were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert to live at Green Gables. During the drive to Avonlea, he exhibited his boundless energy, hugging Marilla and teasing his sister Dora. At Green Gables, he frequently tested Marilla's patience with his table manners, endless questions, and antics like climbing onto the pantry table and accidentally destroying lemon pies. He formed a strong emotional bond with Anne Shirley, who patiently guided his behavior, helped him understand moral lessons, and promised to dye feathers for his Indian headdress. Over time, his behavior improved as he began attending the local school. After the death of his uncle Richard Keith, who left a trust fund for the twins' upkeep, it was settled that Davy and Dora would reside permanently at Green Gables.

- Lived in East Grafton with his sick mother until her death  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don’t believe you mean it. You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ’s old as me?  <sub>[v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)</sub>

> I like Dora because she’s my sister but I like you because you’re you.  <sub>[v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041)</sub>

> Well, I kind of wish I’d said my prayers then. But it’s too much bother getting out now to say them. I’ll say them twice over in the morning, Anne. Won’t that do as well?  <sub>[v2 c19 P43](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0043)</sub>

> I know I’m gooder, and I’ll tell you how I know it. Today Marilla give me two pieces of bread and jam, one for me and one for Dora. One was a good deal bigger than the other and Marilla didn’t say which was mine. But I give the biggest piece to Dora. That was good of me, wasn’t it?  <sub>[v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047)</sub>

> I wanted some feathers for an Injun headdress. Milty Boulter has a dandy one, made out of the feathers his mother give him when she killed their old white gobbler. You might let me have some. That rooster’s got ever so many more’n he wants.  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>
